text:
The assistant's response is entirely incorrect. It fails to extract unique variable names from each equation, does not format the output as a JSON string with one line per equation, and instead produces a nonsensical JSON object with over a hundred keys, most mapping to "c". It includes function names (sum, integral, cos, comb) and constants (pi) as variables, and repeats entries excessively. The response shows no understanding of the task.

Rating: [[1]]
